1. ch2:2-6↗ thm:group-action-riemannian-submersion Prove Theorem 2.28 (if $\pi : \tilde{M} \to M$ is a surjective smooth submersion, and a group acts on $\tilde{M}$ isometrically, vertically, and transitively on fibers, then $M$ inherits a unique Riemannian metric such that $\pi $ is a Riemannian submersion). \end{exercise}
